title: Three Winters and One Short Seal
subtitle: 领袖政治 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 领袖政治（人与社会·历史社会与文化·领袖与政治）
meta: 主题语境：领袖政治（人与社会·历史社会与文化·领袖与政治）　|　核心词汇：leadership　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 leadership 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the mayor ① exercised the leadership that no official in the town would have recorded, and he said the exercising was the whole of the winter. The ② leadership, meaning the authority itself and not the seal, ran three winters and stayed unrecorded in the book; leadership, he said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind of leadership in that town had the same short seal beside it, and the ④ leadership at the far office, meaning the plan they kept for the children to carry out and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Leadership, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the mayor said the recording is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the leadership was the whole of the matter, meaning the trust and not the authority. The ⑥ leadership, meaning the trust and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; leadership, he said, is either something you exercise or the only word that means both authority and a trust. He said the trust is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ leadership had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short seal. The ⑧ leadership of the whole thing, the mayor wrote in November, was one town and three winters of recording; leadership, he said, is either the plan at the far office or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ leadership I remember is the leadership recorded in the report, which closed in 1972 and is still recorded as the quietest in the town. ⑩ Leadership, my mother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all leadership, she said, is a trust that has agreed to look like authority. She said the trust was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 领导力；领导（指镇子里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 领导力；领导（指那种领导力本身，与印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：exercise the leadership 行使这种领导力
D. n. 领导力；领导（指留给孩子们去办的那份打算那一种）
E. n. 为政之事（抽象总称，指一处镇子的领导力之事）
F. n. 领导力；领导（指述职报告里写到、被记载的的那一种）
G. n. 信任、担当（指一件事里人人都服却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 担当（抽象总称，指人人都服却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: exercised the leadership that no official in the town would have recorded
The leadership, meaning the authority itself and not the seal
Every kind of leadership in that town
the leadership at the far office
the leadership was the whole of the matter
the leadership had become a line in a report
The leadership of the whole thing

answers.why: exercise the leadership 意为“行使这种领导力”，1965 年那位镇长把镇子里没有一位干事肯记载的一种领导力做了一遍。
leadership 意为“领导力；领导”，指那种领导力本身而不是印章，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被记载。
leadership 意为“领导力；领导”，指镇子里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
leadership 意为“领导力；领导”，指最远那间办公室留给孩子们去办的那份打算那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
leadership 意为“信任、担当”，指一件事里人人都服却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份担当就是那件事的全部。
leadership 意为“担当”，指人人都服却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种领导力，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
leadership 意为“领导力；领导”，指述职报告里写到、被记载的的那一种，到 1970 年这一种成了述职报告里的一行。
leadership 意为“为政之事”，镇长十一月写道，整件事的领导力之事是一处镇子和三个冬天的记载。
leadership 意为“领导力；领导”，我记得的是述职报告里记载过的那一种，1972 年交清了，至今仍被说成镇子里最安静的一种。
leadership 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，领导力是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的领导力。
